name: Do I need to empty the room before built-in bookcase installation?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to empty the room before built-in bookcase installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, it is highly recommended to completely clear the room where the built-in bookcases will be installed. This allows our team unobstructed access for measurements, material delivery, construction, and finishing work. Removing furniture, decorative items, and clearing pathways prevents damage to your belongings and ensures a more efficient and safer installation process. If there are items that cannot be moved, please discuss this with us in advance so we can plan accordingly and minimize disruption.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, you should fully clear the room before installation to allow our team unobstructed access and prevent damage. Discuss any immovable items with us beforehand.
